title: Addressing the Adjudicator
description: How to write for a reader acting as Adjudicator. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `adjudicator` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: States the outcome, then the reason, then what the reason is scoped to
rules.description: States the outcome, then the reason, then what the reason is scoped to. Never "this is fine": a dispensation with no stated reason is an override nobody can review afterwards.

source.quote: Arrives at a disagreement, not at an artefact. Is given the findings and the checker's output and — deliberately — not the thing being judged, so the verdict measures the disagreement rather than a fresh reading of the source. Needs both sides and the reason each was offered, before needing anything else.
